proposed.title: Keep nested field overrides isolated from shared query data
answers: Why do all series in a Dashboard datasource panel inherit the table column's display name?
How can Time series to table leak units, colors or thresholds into another panel?
How should applyFieldOverrides merge config into nested frames without mutating source data?
proposed.body:
Symptom: A panel using the -- Dashboard -- datasource with withTransforms: false inherits a source table's column display name and styling after Time series to table.
Root cause: packages/grafana-data/src/field/fieldOverrides.ts:applyFieldOverrides merges parent config with defaultsDeep, which mutates its first argument; nested fields can share config objects with source query fields.
Fix pattern: Copy each nested frame and its fields, deep-clone each field's config before merging parent defaults, and apply recursive overrides to the copied frames. Returned nested fields must still receive the parent config.
Constraints: This pattern applies to config merging for FieldType.frame values that may share source data. Shallow config copies are insufficient because defaultsDeep can mutate shared custom or thresholds objects; the required isolation concerns config, not a deep copy of all frame data.
proposed.applies: Changes to nested-frame config propagation in applyFieldOverrides, including frames produced by Time series to table.

proposed.title: Preserve the Dashboard datasource reference during v2 external export
answers: Why does a panel show Random Walk data after sharing and reimporting a dashboard?
How should v2 export handle the -- Dashboard -- datasource?
Preserve queries that reuse another panel’s results when sharing a dashboard
proposed.body:
Symptom: After exporting with “Share dashboard with another instance” and reimporting, a panel that reuses another panel’s results displays generated Random Walk data.
Root cause: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/export/exporters.ts:makeExportableV2 treated the stable -- Dashboard -- reference as an instance-specific datasource UID and removed it.

Constraints: Applies to v2 external exports, including mixed queries and inlined library panels, with query group datasource or dashboard. Match the exact reference; ordinary datasource anonymization, other built-in datasources, migrations, and datasource resolution retain their existing behavior.

proposed.title: Keep missing-series resolution counts compatible with int64 in both rule tables
answers: Why do missing-series resolution counts above 32,767 fail to save?
Support large missing-series evaluation counts on MySQL or PostgreSQL
How should missing-series resolution counts be stored in rule version history?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Saving a missing-series resolution count above 32,767 fails on MySQL or PostgreSQL.
Root cause: SMALLINT database columns could not represent the model’s int64 values; the correction lives in pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/ualert/alert_rule_missing_series_evals_to_resolve.go:ExpandAlertRuleMissingSeriesEvalsToResolve.
Fix pattern: Widen both alert_rule and alert_rule_version columns together to nullable BIGINT; verify persistence in the current rule and its matching version, as in pkg/services/ngalert/store/alert_rule_test.go:TestIntegrationUpdateAlertRules using 43,200 evaluations.
Constraints: Preserve nullability and compatible ranges in both tables. This migration supplies backend-specific SQL for MySQL and PostgreSQL only; it provides no schema alteration for other backends.

proposed.title: Keep OpenFeature evaluation namespaces concrete
answers: Why are flag evaluation requests rejected for a namespace mismatch?
How should OpenFeature handle a wildcard service-token namespace?
Which namespace and targeting key should the evaluation context use?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Flag evaluation requests using a cluster-wide service token are rejected for a namespace mismatch.
Root cause: pkg/services/contexthandler/contexthandler.go:ContextHandler.setRequestContext used the identity's wildcard namespace as the evaluation namespace and targeting key, conflicting with the caller's concrete auth namespace.
Fix pattern: Select a nonempty, non-wildcard identity namespace first; otherwise use "stacks-" + cfg.StackID when set, then "default". Use the selected namespace for both the evaluation context's namespace attribute and targeting key.
Constraints: This selection applies to request OpenFeature evaluation context. A concrete identity namespace takes precedence over StackID; empty or "*" identity namespaces must fall back. pkg/services/contexthandler/contexthandler_test.go:TestContextHandler verifies selection and agreement between the namespace attribute and targeting key.
proposed.applies: Request OpenFeature evaluation context constructed by ContextHandler.setRequestContext.

proposed.title: Observe Combobox positioning only while its menu is open
answers: Why does a Combobox inside collapsed details keep updating?
How should Combobox floating observers follow menu visibility?
Why does the hidden Feature Control Combobox cause repeated input DOM updates?
proposed.body:
Symptom: A Combobox inside collapsed details receives continual size measurements and repeatedly updates its input DOM.
Root cause: packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Combobox/useComboboxFloat.ts:useComboboxFloat registered autoUpdate through whileElementsMounted, so CSS-hidden elements remained observed.
Fix pattern: Start autoUpdate in an effect guarded by isOpen and the presence of both input and floating refs; return its cleanup function.
Constraints: Observe while the menu is open and both elements exist; mounted elements alone do not establish visibility when CSS or collapsed details can hide them.
proposed.applies: Combobox positioning and sizing observation in useComboboxFloat, including CSS-hidden containers.

proposed.title: Skip unchanged computed Combobox size updates
answers: Why does the Combobox rerender for identical size measurements?
How do I prevent unchanged menu dimensions from updating the input DOM?
How should useComboboxFloat deduplicate size callbacks?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Repeated identical menu size measurements rerender the Combobox and update its input DOM despite unchanged visible attributes.
Root cause: packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Combobox/useComboboxFloat.ts:useComboboxFloat called setPopoverMaxSize with a new size object for every measurement.
Fix pattern: Compare computed width and height with a ref holding the last committed dimensions; return when both match, otherwise update the ref before setting state.
Constraints: Compare the final dimensions after sizing calculations, not just raw available space; skip state updates only when both dimensions are unchanged.
proposed.applies: Popover maximum-size state updates in the useComboboxFloat size middleware.

proposed.title: Negotiate aggregated discovery to find CRD-backed groups
answers: Why are CRD-backed resources missing from router discovery?
Why does introspection fail for an aggregated apiextensions-apiserver?
How should the router negotiate and decode /apis responses?
proposed.body:
Symptom: CRD-backed resource groups are missing when an apiextensions-apiserver is configured as a router aggregate target.
Root cause: pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go:discoverGroups queried /apis without requesting aggregated discovery; the standalone apiextensions server's classic response contains a static group map that does not track CRDs.
Fix pattern: Request aggregatedDiscoveryJSON before application/json; pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go:decodeDiscoveryResponse selects aggregated decoding when the response Content-Type contains apidiscovery.k8s.io and converts it to []metav1.APIGroup.
Constraints: Applies to active /apis discovery of aggregate targets. Preserve classic APIGroupList decoding for targets that negotiate down or ignore Accept; choose the decoder from the actual response Content-Type.
proposed.applies: Router active discovery of API groups on aggregate apiserver targets.

proposed.title: Preserve upstream version priority when normalizing discovery
answers: How does the router choose a discovered group's preferred API version?
Why must aggregated discovery versions retain their order?
How should APIGroupDiscoveryList be converted for router discovery?
proposed.body:
pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go:apiGroupDiscoveryListToGroups normalizes aggregated discovery into the classic metav1.APIGroup shape expected by the router.
Preserve each group's upstream version order and construct GroupVersion as group name + "/" + version.
Set PreferredVersion to the first converted version only when versions are present; changing the order changes the preferred version advertised by the router.
proposed.applies: Conversion of aggregated APIGroupDiscoveryList responses into classic router discovery groups.

proposed.title: Strip resourceVersion before branching in v2 dashboard saves
answers: Why does saving a new v2 dashboard fail when resourceVersion is set?
Should v2 dashboard saves include resourceVersion?
Where should dashboard save metadata be sanitized?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Saving a new v2 dashboard fails when the supplied metadata includes resourceVersion.
Root cause: public/app/features/dashboard/api/v2.ts:K8sDashboardV2API.saveDashboard stripped resourceVersion only in the update branch, leaving it in create requests.
Fix pattern: Remove metadata.resourceVersion from the outgoing object before branching between create and update, so both save paths receive sanitized metadata.
Constraints: Applies to both create and update through the v2 dashboard save API; this does not establish a rule for other resource APIs.

proposed.title: Anchor log key matching at word boundaries
answers: Why does the logs panel freeze on a long log line without assignments?
How can log key highlighting avoid catastrophic regex backtracking?
Where is key=value highlighting defined for the logs panel?
proposed.body:
Symptom: The logs panel can stall when highlighting a long word without an '='.
Root cause: public/app/features/logs/components/panel/grammar.ts:logsGrammar — the log-token-key prefix (\b|\B) permits matching at every position, repeatedly scanning suffixes for an assignment and causing quadratic backtracking.
Fix pattern: Restrict candidate key starts to word boundaries with /\b[\w_]+(?=\s*=)/gi while retaining the assignment lookahead.
Constraints: Applies to word-style assignment keys in logs highlighting; preserve recognition of keys such as foo, status, and key_1 before '='. This pattern does not address other token rules.
proposed.applies: Logs panel Prism grammar changes affecting assignment-key recognition or performance on long unassigned words.

proposed.title: Preserve query variable refresh policy during v2 import datasource remapping
answers: Why does importing a dashboard change a query variable's refresh setting?
Should a variable with refresh set to never be upgraded when its datasource changes?
Which query variable settings should survive datasource remapping during UI import?
proposed.body:
Symptom: A query variable's configured refresh setting changes after importing a v2 dashboard and selecting a replacement datasource.
Root cause: public/app/features/manage-dashboards/import/utils/inputs.ts:replaceVariableDatasources rebuilt the variable spec with an explicit refresh override, replacing the author's policy.
Fix pattern: Preserve refresh through the existing spec spread, including onTimeRangeChanged, onDashboardLoad, and never; continue clearing datasource-dependent options and current selection.
Constraints: Applies when v2 import remaps a query variable to a selected datasource. Clearing options does not require upgrading never to onDashboardLoad. Variables retaining a $datasourceVar reference and the v1 import path are outside this replacement behavior.

proposed.title: Preserve comparison values in diff flame graph sandwich transforms
answers: Why do Sandwich view tooltips show NaN or undefined in a diff flame graph?
How should Callers/Callees merges preserve comparison values?
How should diff tooltips handle a missing valueRight?
proposed.body:
Symptom: In a Diff flame graph's Sandwich view (Callers/Callees), Baseline/Comparison/Diff tooltip values display NaN% or undefined.
Root cause: packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/treeTransforms.ts:mergeSubtrees and packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/treeTransforms.ts:getParentSubtrees rebuilt value without preserving valueRight; packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/FlameGraphTooltip.tsx:getDiffTooltipData assumed item.valueRight existed.
Fix pattern: Merge valueRight alongside value using transformed input values, counting missing valueRight as zero when any input carries it; when rebasing parents, copy both values from the child. Normalize missing tooltip item.valueRight to zero before arithmetic and formatting.
Constraints: Comparison-value aggregation applies when at least one merged input has valueRight; non-diff merges must leave valueRight undefined. The tooltip fallback is defensive; accurate comparison values still require the transforms to preserve them.
proposed.applies: Diff flame graph node merging, Sandwich view parent rebasing, and tooltip calculations involving item.valueRight.

proposed.title: MutableDataFrame must accept writes to its derived length during object copying
answers: Why does Explore’s raw Prometheus view crash with multiple instant queries?
Why does cloneDeep(props.data) throw in a plugin under an ESM build?
Why does MutableDataFrame have an empty length setter?
Can RawListContainer use the supplied tableResult directly?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Explore’s raw Prometheus view with two or more instant queries, or a plugin cloning its data, can throw “Cannot set property length … which has only a getter” under strict ESM builds.
Root cause: packages/grafana-data/src/dataframe/MutableDataFrame.ts:MutableDataFrame.length was getter-only; generic copiers recreate the prototype and assign properties, including length. public/app/features/explore/PrometheusListView/RawListContainer.tsx:RawListContainer unnecessarily deep-cloned the merged frame.
Fix pattern: Keep a no-op setter for the derived length so generic copiers can assign it without throwing; read-only consumers such as RawListContainer can use the supplied frame directly.
Constraints: Length remains derived from the first field, so assigning it must not resize the frame or override the getter’s value. Direct frame reuse applies to consumers that only read it; consumers that mutate data need a separate ownership decision.
proposed.applies: Changes to MutableDataFrame’s length accessor, generic frame copying, or Explore’s read-only raw Prometheus list.

proposed.title: Keep annotation tag deletes scoped without forcing a zero tag ID
answers: Removed annotation tags still appear in tag filtering
Why does ensureTags fail to unlink replaced tags?
How should MustCols be used when deleting annotation tag links?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Tags removed from an annotation still appear in annotation tag filtering.
Root cause: pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:ensureTags forced the delete bean's zero TagID into the WHERE clause, adding tag_id = 0 alongside tag_id IN (...).
Fix pattern: Force only annotation_id with MustCols; let In("tag_id", tagsDelete) supply the tag predicate.
Constraints: Applies to link deletion in ensureTags, shared by Add, update and AddMany. Keep annotation_id forced even when zero, or the delete can affect other annotations; this does not repair existing stale links or the separate AddMany write-back defect.
proposed.applies: Changes to annotation tag link deletion in xormRepositoryImpl.ensureTags.

proposed.title: Auto-fit row tracks must shrink with panels while preserving non-fit height
answers: Why is there empty space below a short auto-fit panel?
How should minimum panel height affect auto-grid row sizing?
How do non-fit panels keep their configured row height?
proposed.body:
Symptom: A short auto-fit panel leaves unexpected bottom padding before the next dashboard row.
Root cause: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/layout-auto-grid/AutoGridLayoutManager.tsx:getAutoRowsTemplate reserved the configured row height even when the panel's fit minimum was lower.
Fix pattern: Floor fit-enabled row tracks at min(configured row height, resolved fit minimum), with max-content growth; a minimum of "none" resolves to zero. In public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/layout-auto-grid/AutoGridItemRenderer.tsx:AutoGridItemRenderer, preserve non-fit panels' row-height minimum when row heights are matched and auto-height panels are enabled, or their explicit row height when unmatched.
Constraints: Lower the shared track floor only when fit content is present and fillScreen is false. Clamp larger fit minimums to the configured row height so they do not inflate non-fit-only rows; fit panels contribute their own minimum.
proposed.applies: Dashboard auto-grid sizing with fit-content panels, including layouts mixing fit and non-fit panels.

proposed.title: Keep derived auto-grid row sizing consistent across creation, edits and loading
answers: Why does minimum panel height behave differently after loading a dashboard?
Where must auto-grid row sizing be updated when minimum height changes?
How does a single panel opting into fit content affect grid rows?
proposed.body:
Mechanism: Grid autoRows is derived from row height, fill-screen mode, fit-content presence and minimum height through public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/layout-auto-grid/AutoGridLayoutManager.tsx:getAutoRowsTemplate.
Creation and edits: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/layout-auto-grid/AutoGridLayoutManager.tsx:AutoGridLayoutManager passes the initial minimum; updateAutoRows passes the current minimum, and onMinHeightChanged invokes updateAutoRows after updating state.
Loading: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/serialization/layoutSerializers/AutoGridLayoutSerializer.ts:deserializeAutoGridLayout passes the resolved minimum and enables fit row growth only when auto-height panels are enabled and either the layout default or any child explicitly opts into fit content.
Invariant: Keep these inputs and recomputation paths in sync. Omitting the minimum during creation or loading restores the row-height floor; skipping recomputation after an edit leaves stale row sizing.
proposed.applies: Changes to auto-grid minimum-height settings, derived row templates or layout deserialization.

Root cause: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/layout-auto-grid/AutoGridLayoutManager.tsx:getAutoRowsTemplate reserved the configured row height even when the panel's fit minimum was lower.
Fix pattern: Floor fit-enabled row tracks at min(configured row height, resolved fit minimum), with max-content growth; a minimum of "none" resolves to zero. In public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/layout-auto-grid/AutoGridItemRenderer.tsx:AutoGridItemRenderer, preserve non-fit panels' row-height minimum when row heights are matched and auto-height panels are enabled, or their explicit row height when unmatched.
Constraints: Lower the shared track floor only when fit content is present and fillScreen is false. Clamp larger fit minimums to the configured row height so they do not inflate non-fit-only rows; fit panels contribute their own minimum.

saved.title: Keep derived auto-grid row sizing consistent across creation, edits and loading
saved.body:
Mechanism: Grid autoRows is derived from row height, fill-screen mode, fit-content presence and minimum height through public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/layout-auto-grid/AutoGridLayoutManager.tsx:getAutoRowsTemplate.
Creation and edits: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/layout-auto-grid/AutoGridLayoutManager.tsx:AutoGridLayoutManager passes the initial minimum; updateAutoRows passes the current minimum, and onMinHeightChanged invokes updateAutoRows after updating state.
Loading: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/serialization/layoutSerializers/AutoGridLayoutSerializer.ts:deserializeAutoGridLayout passes the resolved minimum and enables fit row growth only when auto-height panels are enabled and either the layout default or any child explicitly opts into fit content.
Invariant: Keep these inputs and recomputation paths in sync. Omitting the minimum during creation or loading restores the row-height floor; skipping recomputation after an edit leaves stale row sizing.

proposed.title: Preserve datasource type and UID in trace correlation queries
answers: Show context says No more logs available after clicking Logs for this span
Datasource-specific log context controls are missing after navigating from a trace
What datasource reference must trace-to-logs and trace-to-metrics queries carry?
proposed.body:
Symptom: After clicking Logs for this span, Show context displays “No more logs available” instead of surrounding logs and datasource-specific controls.
Root cause: public/app/features/explore/TraceView/createSpanLink.tsx:legacyCreateSpanLinkFactory generated inner queries without datasource.type; a UID alone allowed execution but did not reliably identify the plugin.
Fix pattern: Attach datasource: { type, uid } from the target datasource settings to generated logs and metrics queries, including interpolated alternative log queries.
Constraints: Preserve the complete reference with dynamic trace-to-logs queries both enabled and disabled. The Explore pane's datasource UID does not replace the reference required on each inner query.
proposed.applies: Explore trace-to-logs and trace-to-metrics link generation, including alternative log queries.
